possible_model_blind_spots: INFERENCE: Global molecular offsets or loading corrections cannot represent the observed endpoint-specific interactions and heterogeneous ratio slopes. ML PRIOR: Related structures can support transfer, but functional-group counts and broad descriptor similarity do not determine response shape. CHEMICAL PRIORS: Adsorption, focusing and hydrogen bonding remain possible explanations rather than measured mechanisms. Moving a failed transition hypothesis to a farther boundary solely because the model predicts growth there has weak evidential support.
possible_learning_bottlenecks: INFERENCE: m75 and m32 repeats expose variation among identical represented inputs. Measurement variation, annotation/integration differences and omitted run conditions remain competing explanations. Two records per input do not identify an irreducible noise distribution or universal noise floor. ML PRIOR: Retain individual labels and provenance; use replicate-aware summaries and sensitivity checks so singleton extrema do not become deterministic surfaces. Training-only residuals and matched finite differences can distinguish poor fitting of acquired labels from a coverage gap. This packet cannot identify feature scaling, regularization, optimization or omitted variables as the cause.

Group by molecule and all five conditions: 9d3f3505ff1be86befbe and 35e055b13ba20e843f0d are identical m12 inputs. Multiplicity is neither independent diversity nor Row prevalence. Recent m69/m70, m130/m144, m53, m18 and m201 sequences answer their immediate questions; routine grid completion has diminishing value. Row weights and the accuracy metric are unspecified.
